children: Machi Big Brother's ETH long position had more than $60,000 in unrealized profit, while his HYPE long was reduced to 4,200 tokens. According to Odaily, Hyperbot data showed the 25x-leveraged ETH position had grown to 2,925 ETH, with an unrealized profit of about $63,700; the HYPE position had an unrealized loss of about $12,800. Yuga Grails OTC previously said it had matched over-the-counter sales of BAYC #950 and BAYC #5310, with Adam Weitsman as the buyer and Machi Big Brother as the seller.

title: Machi Big Brother's ETH Long Tops $60,000 in Unrealized Profit as HYPE Position Falls to 4,200
